title: Godox Warranty
content: Godox products supplied through the UK business include applicable UK warranty support. Customers should check the individual product terms.

title: UK Delivery
content: In-stock products can be dispatched using the available UK delivery options. Delivery timing depends on the selected service and product availability.

title: Photography Advice
content: Portable battery flashes are useful for wedding and location photographers because they provide flexibility without requiring mains power.

title: AD200 Pro II
content: The AD200 Pro II is a compact portable flash and is suitable for photographers who need portable lighting for location, portrait and wedding work.

title: AD400PRO-II
content: The AD400PRO-II provides more power than the AD200 Pro II and is suitable when additional lighting output is required for portraits, weddings or commercial work.
